summary: Tested Auto-Reply Feature for Focus Mode (DND). All 10 backend API tests pass. Frontend tests pass - Profile page shows auto-reply toggle and message input, Chat page renders auto-reply messages with 'Automatische Antwort' label and BellOff icon.
critical_code_review_comments: Code correctly implements all requested auto-reply features:
- PUT /api/users/profile accepts auto_reply_enabled and auto_reply_message fields
- GET /api/users/profile returns auto_reply_enabled and auto_reply_message fields
- Auto-reply messages are created with type='auto-reply' when message sent to DND user with auto_reply_enabled=true
- Auto-reply throttling works correctly (max 1 per conversation per 30 minutes)
- Auto-reply is sent as reply_to the triggering message with reply_preview
- No auto-reply for bot commands (messages starting with /)
- Profile page has auto-reply toggle (data-testid='auto-reply-toggle') and message input (data-testid='auto-reply-message-input')
- Chat page renders auto-reply messages with 'Automatische Antwort' label, BellOff icon, and italic text
seed_data_creation: Created test users (test_autoreply_*@test.com) and conversations for auto-reply testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auto-reply feature is fully functional. Admin user has auto_reply_enabled=true with message 'Bin in Fokus-Modus, antworte spaeter!'. When a message is sent to admin (who is in DND/focus mode), an auto-reply message with type='auto-reply' is automatically created. Throttling limits to 1 auto-reply per conversation per 30 minutes.
